<Tag slot="tag">

<TagTitle slot="title">

# Beta Connectors Endpoints

</TagTitle>

<TagDescription slot="description">

(beta) Connectors API - manage your connectors

</TagDescription>

</Tag>

<Operation>

<OperationTitleSection slot="title">

## <Pill variant="primary"><b>GET</b></Pill> /v1/connectors \{#operation-connector_list_v1\}

</OperationTitleSection>

<OperationSummarySection slot="summary">

_List all connectors._

</OperationSummarySection>

<OperationDescriptionSection slot="description">

List all your custom connectors with keyset pagination and filters.

</OperationDescriptionSection>

<OperationCodeSamplesSection slot="code-samples">

<CodeSampleTabbedSection>

<CodeSampleTab
  slot="tab"
  id="operation-connector_list_v1_code-samples_typescript"
  tags={{"codeSample":"typescript"}}
>

TypeScript

</CodeSampleTab>

<SectionContent slot="content" id="operation-connector_list_v1_code-samples_typescript">

<CodeSample>

```typescript
import { Mistral } from "@mistralai/mistralai";

const mistral = new Mistral({
  apiKey: process.env["MISTRAL_API_KEY"] ?? "",
});

async function run() {
  const result = await mistral.beta.connectors.list({});

  console.log(result);
}

run();
```

</CodeSample>

</SectionContent>

<CodeSampleTab
  slot="tab"
  id="operation-connector_list_v1_code-samples_python"
  tags={{"codeSample":"python"}}
>

Python

</CodeSampleTab>

<SectionContent
  slot="content"
  id="operation-connector_list_v1_code-samples_python"
>

<SDKVersionCodeSample>
<div data-version="v2">
<CodeSample>

```python
from mistralai.client import Mistral
import os


with Mistral(
    api_key=os.getenv("MISTRAL_API_KEY", ""),
) as mistral:

    res = mistral.beta.connectors.list(page_size=100)

    # Handle response
    print(res)


```

</CodeSample>
</div>

</SDKVersionCodeSample>

<ExpandablePropertyDescription slot="description">

HTTP status codes and reason phrases

Status codes from the following RFCs are all observed:

    * RFC 7231: Hypertext Transfer Protocol (HTTP/1.1), obsoletes 2616
    * RFC 6585: Additional HTTP Status Codes
    * RFC 3229: Delta encoding in HTTP
    * RFC 4918: HTTP Extensions for WebDAV, obsoletes 2518
    * RFC 5842: Binding Extensions to WebDAV
    * RFC 7238: Permanent Redirect
    * RFC 2295: Transparent Content Negotiation in HTTP
    * RFC 2774: An HTTP Extension Framework
    * RFC 7725: An HTTP Status Code to Report Legal Obstacles
    * RFC 7540: Hypertext Transfer Protocol Version 2 (HTTP/2)
    * RFC 2324: Hyper Text Coffee Pot Control Protocol (HTCPCP/1.0)
    * RFC 8297: An HTTP Status Code for Indicating Hints
    * RFC 8470: Using Early Data in HTTP

</ExpandablePropertyDescription>

#### ExtendedOAuthServerMetadata \{#operation-connector_list_v1_responses_200_application-json_items_mcpconnector_supported_auth_methods_publicauthenticationmethod_oauth2_server_metadata_extendedoauthservermetadata\}

</ExpandableBreakoutTitle>

<ExpandableBreakoutDescription slot="description">

Custom superset of RFC 8414 OAuth 2.0 Authorization Server Metadata.

Stored at connector creation time (provided for HTTP connectors, discovered via .well-known for MCP).
Mirrors the shape of .well-known/oauth-authorization-server responses.

</ExpandableBreakoutDescription>

<ExpandablePropertyDescription slot="description">

HTTP status codes and reason phrases

Status codes from the following RFCs are all observed:

    * RFC 7231: Hypertext Transfer Protocol (HTTP/1.1), obsoletes 2616
    * RFC 6585: Additional HTTP Status Codes
    * RFC 3229: Delta encoding in HTTP
    * RFC 4918: HTTP Extensions for WebDAV, obsoletes 2518
    * RFC 5842: Binding Extensions to WebDAV
    * RFC 7238: Permanent Redirect
    * RFC 2295: Transparent Content Negotiation in HTTP
    * RFC 2774: An HTTP Extension Framework
    * RFC 7725: An HTTP Status Code to Report Legal Obstacles
    * RFC 7540: Hypertext Transfer Protocol Version 2 (HTTP/2)
    * RFC 2324: Hyper Text Coffee Pot Control Protocol (HTCPCP/1.0)
    * RFC 8297: An HTTP Status Code for Indicating Hints
    * RFC 8470: Using Early Data in HTTP

</ExpandablePropertyDescription>

received from untrusted servers.

<Operation>

<OperationTitleSection slot="title">

## <Pill variant="primary"><b>POST</b></Pill> /v1/connectors \{#operation-connector_create_v1\}

</OperationTitleSection>

<OperationSummarySection slot="summary">

_Create a new connector._

</OperationSummarySection>

<OperationDescriptionSection slot="description">

Create a new MCP or HTTP connector. You can customize its visibility, URL, and auth type.

</OperationDescriptionSection>

<OperationCodeSamplesSection slot="code-samples">

<CodeSampleTabbedSection>

<CodeSampleTab
  slot="tab"
  id="operation-connector_create_v1_code-samples_typescript"
  tags={{"codeSample":"typescript"}}
>

TypeScript

</CodeSampleTab>

<SectionContent slot="content" id="operation-connector_create_v1_code-samples_typescript">

<CodeSample>

```typescript
import { Mistral } from "@mistralai/mistralai";

const mistral = new Mistral({
  apiKey: process.env["MISTRAL_API_KEY"] ?? "",
});

async function run() {
  const result = await mistral.beta.connectors.create({
    name: "<value>",
    description: "unibody usually despite slushy wherever reward stingy from",
    server: "https://royal-majority.net/",
    protocol: "mcp",
  });

  console.log(result);
}

run();
```

</CodeSample>

</SectionContent>

<CodeSampleTab
  slot="tab"
  id="operation-connector_create_v1_code-samples_python"
  tags={{"codeSample":"python"}}
>

Python

</CodeSampleTab>

<SectionContent
  slot="content"
  id="operation-connector_create_v1_code-samples_python"
>

<SDKVersionCodeSample>
<div data-version="v2">
<CodeSample>

```python
from mistralai.client import Mistral
import os


with Mistral(
    api_key=os.getenv("MISTRAL_API_KEY", ""),
) as mistral:

    res = mistral.beta.connectors.create(name="<value>", description="unibody usually despite slushy wherever reward stingy from", server="https://royal-majority.net/")

    # Handle response
    print(res)


```

</CodeSample>
</div>

</SDKVersionCodeSample>

</SectionContent>

```curl
 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
 -d '{
  "description": "My resource description.",
  "name": "My resource",
  "server": "https://mcp.example.com"
}'
```

<ExpandablePropertyDescription slot="description">

Custom superset of RFC 8414 OAuth 2.0 Authorization Server Metadata.

Stored at connector creation time (provided for HTTP connectors, discovered via .well-known for MCP).

<ExpandablePropertyDescription slot="description">

HTTP status codes and reason phrases

Status codes from the following RFCs are all observed:

    * RFC 7231: Hypertext Transfer Protocol (HTTP/1.1), obsoletes 2616
    * RFC 6585: Additional HTTP Status Codes
    * RFC 3229: Delta encoding in HTTP
    * RFC 4918: HTTP Extensions for WebDAV, obsoletes 2518
    * RFC 5842: Binding Extensions to WebDAV
    * RFC 7238: Permanent Redirect
    * RFC 2295: Transparent Content Negotiation in HTTP
    * RFC 2774: An HTTP Extension Framework
    * RFC 7725: An HTTP Status Code to Report Legal Obstacles
    * RFC 7540: Hypertext Transfer Protocol Version 2 (HTTP/2)
    * RFC 2324: Hyper Text Coffee Pot Control Protocol (HTCPCP/1.0)
    * RFC 8297: An HTTP Status Code for Indicating Hints
    * RFC 8470: Using Early Data in HTTP

</ExpandablePropertyDescription>

<ExpandablePropertyDescription slot="description">

Additional properties describing a Tool to clients.

NOTE: all properties in ToolAnnotations are **hints**.
They are not guaranteed to provide a faithful description of
tool behavior (including descriptive properties like `title`).

Clients should never make tool use decisions based on ToolAnnotations
received from untrusted servers.

</ExpandablePropertyDescription>

##### error_http_code \{#operation-connector_create_v1_responses_201_application-json_httpconnector_connection_credentials_authenticationconfiguration_status_credentialsstatus_error_http_code\}

</ExpandablePropertyTitle>

<ExpandablePropertyDescription slot="description">

HTTP status codes and reason phrases

Status codes from the following RFCs are all observed:

    * RFC 7231: Hypertext Transfer Protocol (HTTP/1.1), obsoletes 2616
    * RFC 6585: Additional HTTP Status Codes
    * RFC 3229: Delta encoding in HTTP
    * RFC 4918: HTTP Extensions for WebDAV, obsoletes 2518
    * RFC 5842: Binding Extensions to WebDAV
    * RFC 7238: Permanent Redirect

<ExpandablePropertyDescription slot="description">

Additional properties describing a Tool to clients.

NOTE: all properties in ToolAnnotations are **hints**.
They are not guaranteed to provide a faithful description of
tool behavior (including descriptive properties like `title`).

Clients should never make tool use decisions based on ToolAnnotations
received from untrusted servers.

</ExpandablePropertyDescription>

<ExpandablePropertyDescription slot="description">

Custom superset of RFC 8414 OAuth 2.0 Authorization Server Metadata.

Stored at connector creation time (provided for HTTP connectors, discovered via .well-known for MCP).

## <Pill variant="primary"><b>GET</b></Pill> /v1/connectors/\{connector\_id\_or\_name\}/auth\_url \{#operation-connector_get_auth_url_v1\}

</OperationTitleSection>

<OperationSummarySection slot="summary">

_Get the auth URL for a connector._

</OperationSummarySection>

<OperationDescriptionSection slot="description">

Get the OAuth2 authorization URL for a connector to initiate user authentication.

</OperationDescriptionSection>

<OperationCodeSamplesSection slot="code-samples">

<CodeSampleTabbedSection>

```typescript
import { Mistral } from "@mistralai/mistralai";

const mistral = new Mistral({
  apiKey: process.env["MISTRAL_API_KEY"] ?? "",
});

async function run() {
  const result = await mistral.beta.connectors.getAuthUrl({
    connectorIdOrName: "<value>",
  });

  console.log(result);
}

run();
```

## <Pill variant="primary"><b>PUT</b></Pill> /v1/connectors/\{connector\_id\}/share \{#operation-connector_share_v1\}

</OperationTitleSection>

<OperationSummarySection slot="summary">

_Share a private connector to the current workspace._

</OperationSummarySection>

<OperationDescriptionSection slot="description">

Transfers ownership of a private user-owned connector to the current workspace, making it available to all workspace members. The creator can later revert this via the unshare endpoint. Any authentication flows that rely on the original owner's identity (e.g. OAuth on-behalf-of) will be affected and must be reconfigured after sharing. Only the connector's creator can call this endpoint. Requires the ShareConnectorToWorkspace workspace permission.

</OperationDescriptionSection>

```typescript
  apiKey: process.env["MISTRAL_API_KEY"] ?? "",
});

async function run() {
  const result = await mistral.beta.connectors.share({
    connectorId: "cf748b50-632b-46d6-98c3-b015086cb194",
  });

  console.log(result);
}

run();
```

## <Pill variant="primary"><b>DELETE</b></Pill> /v1/connectors/\{connector\_id\}/share \{#operation-connector_unshare_v1\}

</OperationTitleSection>

<OperationSummarySection slot="summary">

_Unshare a connector from the current workspace._

</OperationSummarySection>

<OperationDescriptionSection slot="description">

Reverts a workspace-shared connector back to a private, creator-owned connector. Workspace-scoped connections and other members' connections are removed; the creator's own connection is preserved. Only the connector's creator can call this endpoint. Requires the ShareConnectorToWorkspace workspace permission.

<Operation>

<OperationTitleSection slot="title">

## <Pill variant="primary"><b>GET</b></Pill> /v1/connectors/\{connector\_id\_or\_name\}/tools \{#operation-connector_list_tools_v1\}

</OperationTitleSection>

<OperationSummarySection slot="summary">

_List tools for a connector._

</OperationSummarySection>

<OperationDescriptionSection slot="description">

List all tools available for an MCP connector.

</OperationDescriptionSection>

<OperationCodeSamplesSection slot="code-samples">

<CodeSampleTabbedSection>

<CodeSampleTab
  slot="tab"
  id="operation-connector_list_tools_v1_code-samples_typescript"
  tags={{"codeSample":"typescript"}}
>

TypeScript

</CodeSampleTab>

<SectionContent slot="content" id="operation-connector_list_tools_v1_code-samples_typescript">

<CodeSample>

```typescript
import { Mistral } from "@mistralai/mistralai";

const mistral = new Mistral({
  apiKey: process.env["MISTRAL_API_KEY"] ?? "",
});

async function run() {
  const result = await mistral.beta.connectors.listTools({
    connectorIdOrName: "<value>",
  });

  console.log(result);
}

run();
```

</CodeSample>

</SectionContent>

<CodeSampleTab
  slot="tab"
  id="operation-connector_list_tools_v1_code-samples_python"
  tags={{"codeSample":"python"}}
>

Python

</CodeSampleTab>

<SectionContent
  slot="content"
  id="operation-connector_list_tools_v1_code-samples_python"
>

<SDKVersionCodeSample>
<div data-version="v2">
<CodeSample>

```python
from mistralai.client import Mistral
import os


with Mistral(
    api_key=os.getenv("MISTRAL_API_KEY", ""),
) as mistral:

    res = mistral.beta.connectors.list_tools(connector_id_or_name="<value>", page=1, page_size=100, refresh=False, pretty=False)

    # Handle response
    print(res)


```

</CodeSample>
</div>

</SDKVersionCodeSample>

</SectionContent>

<CodeSampleTab
  slot="tab"
  id="operation-connector_list_tools_v1_code-samples_curl"
  tags={{"codeSample":"curl"}}
>

cURL

</CodeSampleTab>

<SectionContent slot="content" id="operation-connector_list_tools_v1_code-samples_curl">

```curl
curl https://api.mistral.ai/v1/connectors/{connector_id_or_name}/tools \
 -X GET \
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_APIKEY_HERE'
```

</CodeSample>

<OperationTitleSection slot="title">

## <Pill variant="primary"><b>GET</b></Pill> /v1/connectors/\{connector\_id\_or\_name\}/authentication\_methods \{#operation-connector_get_authentication_methods_v1\}

</OperationTitleSection>

<OperationSummarySection slot="summary">

_Get authentication methods for a connector._

</OperationSummarySection>

<OperationDescriptionSection slot="description">

Get the authentication schema for a connector. Returns the list of supported authentication methods and their required headers.

</OperationDescriptionSection>

<OperationCodeSamplesSection slot="code-samples">

<CodeSampleTabbedSection>

<CodeSampleTab
  slot="tab"
  id="operation-connector_get_authentication_methods_v1_code-samples_typescript"
  tags={{"codeSample":"typescript"}}
>

TypeScript

</CodeSampleTab>

<SectionContent
  slot="content"
  id="operation-connector_get_authentication_methods_v1_code-samples_typescript"
>

<CodeSample>

```typescript
import { Mistral } from "@mistralai/mistralai";

const mistral = new Mistral({
  apiKey: process.env["MISTRAL_API_KEY"] ?? "",
});

async function run() {
  const result = await mistral.beta.connectors.getAuthenticationMethods({
    connectorIdOrName: "<value>",
  });

  console.log(result);
}

run();
```

</CodeSample>

</SectionContent>

<CodeSampleTab
  slot="tab"
  id="operation-connector_get_authentication_methods_v1_code-samples_python"
  tags={{"codeSample":"python"}}
>

Python

</CodeSampleTab>

<SectionContent
  slot="content"
  id="operation-connector_get_authentication_methods_v1_code-samples_python"
>

<SDKVersionCodeSample>
<div data-version="v2">
<CodeSample>

```python
from mistralai.client import Mistral
import os


with Mistral(
    api_key=os.getenv("MISTRAL_API_KEY", ""),
) as mistral:

    res = mistral.beta.connectors.get_authentication_methods(connector_id_or_name="<value>")

    # Handle response
    print(res)


```

</CodeSample>
</div>

</SDKVersionCodeSample>

</SectionContent>

  slot="tab"

<OperationTitleSection slot="title">

## <Pill variant="primary"><b>GET</b></Pill> /v1/connectors/\{connector\_id\_or\_name\}/organization/credentials \{#operation-connector_list_organization_credentials_v1\}

</OperationTitleSection>

<OperationSummarySection slot="summary">

_List organization credentials for a connector._

</OperationSummarySection>

<OperationDescriptionSection slot="description">

List all credentials configured at the organization level for a given connector.

</OperationDescriptionSection>

<OperationCodeSamplesSection slot="code-samples">

<CodeSampleTabbedSection>

<CodeSampleTab
  slot="tab"
  id="operation-connector_list_organization_credentials_v1_code-samples_typescript"
  tags={{"codeSample":"typescript"}}
>

TypeScript

</CodeSampleTab>

<SectionContent
  slot="content"
  id="operation-connector_list_organization_credentials_v1_code-samples_typescript"
>

<CodeSample>

```typescript
import { Mistral } from "@mistralai/mistralai";

const mistral = new Mistral({
  apiKey: process.env["MISTRAL_API_KEY"] ?? "",
});

async function run() {
  const result = await mistral.beta.connectors.listOrganizationCredentials({
    connectorIdOrName: "<value>",
  });

  console.log(result);
}

run();
```

</CodeSample>

</SectionContent>

<CodeSampleTab
  slot="tab"
  id="operation-connector_list_organization_credentials_v1_code-samples_python"
  tags={{"codeSample":"python"}}
>

Python

</CodeSampleTab>

<SectionContent
  slot="content"
  id="operation-connector_list_organization_credentials_v1_code-samples_python"
>

<SDKVersionCodeSample>
<div data-version="v2">
<CodeSample>

```python
from mistralai.client import Mistral
import os


with Mistral(
    api_key=os.getenv("MISTRAL_API_KEY", ""),
) as mistral:

    res = mistral.beta.connectors.list_organization_credentials(connector_id_or_name="<value>", fetch_default=False)

    # Handle response
    print(res)


```

</CodeSample>
</div>

</SDKVersionCodeSample>

<OperationTitleSection slot="title">

## <Pill variant="primary"><b>GET</b></Pill> /v1/connectors/\{connector\_id\_or\_name\}/workspace/credentials \{#operation-connector_list_workspace_credentials_v1\}

</OperationTitleSection>

<OperationSummarySection slot="summary">

_List workspace credentials for a connector._

</OperationSummarySection>

<OperationDescriptionSection slot="description">

List all credentials configured at the workspace level for a given connector.

</OperationDescriptionSection>

<OperationCodeSamplesSection slot="code-samples">

<CodeSampleTabbedSection>

<CodeSampleTab
  slot="tab"

TypeScript

</CodeSampleTab>

<SectionContent
  slot="content"
  id="operation-connector_list_workspace_credentials_v1_code-samples_typescript"
>

<CodeSample>

```typescript
import { Mistral } from "@mistralai/mistralai";

const mistral = new Mistral({
  apiKey: process.env["MISTRAL_API_KEY"] ?? "",
});

async function run() {
  const result = await mistral.beta.connectors.listWorkspaceCredentials({
    connectorIdOrName: "<value>",
  });

  console.log(result);
}

run();
```

</CodeSample>

</SectionContent>

  slot="tab"

Python

<SectionContent
  slot="content"
  id="operation-connector_list_workspace_credentials_v1_code-samples_python"
>

<SDKVersionCodeSample>
<div data-version="v2">
<CodeSample>

```python
from mistralai.client import Mistral
import os


with Mistral(
    api_key=os.getenv("MISTRAL_API_KEY", ""),
) as mistral:

    res = mistral.beta.connectors.list_workspace_credentials(connector_id_or_name="<value>", fetch_default=False)

    # Handle response
    print(res)


```

</CodeSample>
</div>

<OperationTitleSection slot="title">

## <Pill variant="primary"><b>GET</b></Pill> /v1/connectors/\{connector\_id\_or\_name\}/user/credentials \{#operation-connector_list_user_credentials_v1\}

</OperationTitleSection>

<OperationSummarySection slot="summary">

_List user credentials for a connector._

</OperationSummarySection>

<OperationDescriptionSection slot="description">

List all credentials configured at the user level for a given connector.

</OperationDescriptionSection>

<OperationCodeSamplesSection slot="code-samples">

<CodeSampleTabbedSection>

<CodeSampleTab
  slot="tab"
  id="operation-connector_list_user_credentials_v1_code-samples_typescript"
  tags={{"codeSample":"typescript"}}
>

TypeScript

</CodeSampleTab>

<SectionContent
  slot="content"
  id="operation-connector_list_user_credentials_v1_code-samples_typescript"
>

<CodeSample>

```typescript
import { Mistral } from "@mistralai/mistralai";

const mistral = new Mistral({
  apiKey: process.env["MISTRAL_API_KEY"] ?? "",
});

async function run() {
  const result = await mistral.beta.connectors.listUserCredentials({
    connectorIdOrName: "<value>",
  });

  console.log(result);
}

run();
```

</CodeSample>

</SectionContent>

<CodeSampleTab
  slot="tab"
  id="operation-connector_list_user_credentials_v1_code-samples_python"
  tags={{"codeSample":"python"}}
>

Python

</CodeSampleTab>

<SectionContent
  slot="content"
  id="operation-connector_list_user_credentials_v1_code-samples_python"
>

<SDKVersionCodeSample>
<div data-version="v2">
<CodeSample>

```python
from mistralai.client import Mistral
import os


with Mistral(
    api_key=os.getenv("MISTRAL_API_KEY", ""),
) as mistral:

    res = mistral.beta.connectors.list_user_credentials(connector_id_or_name="<value>", fetch_default=False)

    # Handle response
    print(res)


```

</CodeSample>
</div>

</SDKVersionCodeSample>

</SectionContent>

## <Pill variant="primary"><b>DELETE</b></Pill> /v1/connectors/\{connector\_id\_or\_name\}/user/credentials \{#operation-connector_delete_all_user_credentials_v1\}

</OperationTitleSection>

<OperationSummarySection slot="summary">

_Delete all user credentials for a connector._

</OperationSummarySection>

<OperationDescriptionSection slot="description">

Delete all credentials configured at the user level for a given connector.

</OperationDescriptionSection>

<OperationCodeSamplesSection slot="code-samples">

<CodeSampleTabbedSection>

  slot="tab"

<SectionContent
  slot="content"

>

<CodeSample>

```curl
curl https://api.mistral.ai/v1/connectors/{connector_id_or_name}/user/credentials \
 -X DELETE \
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_APIKEY_HERE' \
 -H 'Content-Type: application/json'
```

</CodeSample>

</SectionContent>

  slot="content"
  id="operation-connector_delete_all_user_credentials_v1_code-samples_typescript"
>

<CodeSample>

```typescript
import { Mistral } from "@mistralai/mistralai";

const mistral = new Mistral({
  apiKey: process.env["MISTRAL_API_KEY"] ?? "",
});

async function run() {
  const result = await mistral.beta.connectors.deleteAllUserCredentials({
    connectorIdOrName: "5d332e4a-b496-4634-bfa5-8233e837b143",
  });

  console.log(result);
}

run();
```

</CodeSample>

```typescript
import { Mistral } from "@mistralai/mistralai";

const mistral = new Mistral({
  apiKey: process.env["MISTRAL_API_KEY"] ?? "",
});

async function run() {
  const result = await mistral.beta.connectors.createCredentials({
    connectorIdOrName: "b7170011-bca4-40c2-8f3d-4f646a544062",
    consumerScope: "organization",
    credentialsCreateOrUpdate: {
      name: "<value>",
    },
  });

  console.log(result);
}

run();
```

<ExpandablePropertyTitle slot="title">

##### is_default \{#operation-connector_create_credentials_v1_request_is_default\}

</ExpandablePropertyTitle>

<ExpandablePropertyDescription slot="description">

Controls whether this credential is the default for its auth method. On creation: if no credential exists yet for this auth method, the credential is automatically set as default when is_default is true or omitted; setting is_default to false is rejected because a default must exist. If other credentials already exist, setting is_default to true promotes this credential (demoting the previous default); false or omitted creates it as non-default. On update: true promotes this credential, false is rejected if it is currently the default (promote another credential first), omitted leaves the default status unchanged.

</ExpandablePropertyDescription>

</ExpandableProperty>

<ExpandablePropertyTitle slot="title">

##### is_default \{#operation-connector_update_credentials_request_is_default\}

</ExpandablePropertyTitle>

<ExpandablePropertyDescription slot="description">

Controls whether this credential is the default for its auth method. On creation: if no credential exists yet for this auth method, the credential is automatically set as default when is_default is true or omitted; setting is_default to false is rejected because a default must exist. If other credentials already exist, setting is_default to true promotes this credential (demoting the previous default); false or omitted creates it as non-default. On update: true promotes this credential, false is rejected if it is currently the default (promote another credential first), omitted leaves the default status unchanged.

</ExpandablePropertyDescription>

</ExpandableProperty>

HTTP status codes and reason phrases

Status codes from the following RFCs are all observed:

    * RFC 7231: Hypertext Transfer Protocol (HTTP/1.1), obsoletes 2616
    * RFC 6585: Additional HTTP Status Codes
    * RFC 3229: Delta encoding in HTTP
    * RFC 4918: HTTP Extensions for WebDAV, obsoletes 2518
    * RFC 5842: Binding Extensions to WebDAV
    * RFC 7238: Permanent Redirect
    * RFC 2295: Transparent Content Negotiation in HTTP
    * RFC 2774: An HTTP Extension Framework
    * RFC 7725: An HTTP Status Code to Report Legal Obstacles
    * RFC 7540: Hypertext Transfer Protocol Version 2 (HTTP/2)
    * RFC 2324: Hyper Text Coffee Pot Control Protocol (HTCPCP/1.0)
    * RFC 8297: An HTTP Status Code for Indicating Hints
    * RFC 8470: Using Early Data in HTTP

</ExpandablePropertyDescription>

</ExpandableProperty>

Additional properties describing a Tool to clients.

tool behavior (including descriptive properties like `title`).

Clients should never make tool use decisions based on ToolAnnotations
received from untrusted servers.

<ExpandablePropertyDescription slot="description">

Custom superset of RFC 8414 OAuth 2.0 Authorization Server Metadata.

Stored at connector creation time (provided for HTTP connectors, discovered via .well-known for MCP).
Mirrors the shape of .well-known/oauth-authorization-server responses.

##### error_http_code \{#operation-connector_get_v1_responses_200_application-json_httpconnector_connection_credentials_authenticationconfiguration_status_credentialsstatus_error_http_code\}

</ExpandablePropertyTitle>

<ExpandablePropertyDescription slot="description">

HTTP status codes and reason phrases

Status codes from the following RFCs are all observed:

    * RFC 7231: Hypertext Transfer Protocol (HTTP/1.1), obsoletes 2616
    * RFC 6585: Additional HTTP Status Codes
    * RFC 3229: Delta encoding in HTTP
    * RFC 4918: HTTP Extensions for WebDAV, obsoletes 2518
    * RFC 5842: Binding Extensions to WebDAV
    * RFC 7238: Permanent Redirect
    * RFC 2295: Transparent Content Negotiation in HTTP
    * RFC 2774: An HTTP Extension Framework
    * RFC 7725: An HTTP Status Code to Report Legal Obstacles
    * RFC 7540: Hypertext Transfer Protocol Version 2 (HTTP/2)
    * RFC 2324: Hyper Text Coffee Pot Control Protocol (HTCPCP/1.0)
    * RFC 8297: An HTTP Status Code for Indicating Hints
    * RFC 8470: Using Early Data in HTTP

</ExpandablePropertyDescription>

Additional properties describing a Tool to clients.

NOTE: all properties in ToolAnnotations are **hints**.

tool behavior (including descriptive properties like `title`).

Clients should never make tool use decisions based on ToolAnnotations
received from untrusted servers.

Custom superset of RFC 8414 OAuth 2.0 Authorization Server Metadata.

Stored at connector creation time (provided for HTTP connectors, discovered via .well-known for MCP).

## <Pill variant="primary"><b>DELETE</b></Pill> /v1/connectors/\{connector\_id\}\#id \{#operation-connector_delete_v1\}

</OperationTitleSection>

<OperationSummarySection slot="summary">

_Delete a connector._

</OperationSummarySection>

<OperationDescriptionSection slot="description">

Delete a connector by its ID.

</OperationDescriptionSection>

TypeScript

<SectionContent slot="content" id="operation-connector_delete_v1_code-samples_typescript">

<CodeSample>

```typescript
import { Mistral } from "@mistralai/mistralai";

const mistral = new Mistral({
  apiKey: process.env["MISTRAL_API_KEY"] ?? "",
});

async function run() {
  const result = await mistral.beta.connectors.delete({
    connectorId: "5c3269fe-6a18-4216-b1fb-b093005874cd",
  });

  console.log(result);
}

run();
```

```python
import os


with Mistral(
    api_key=os.getenv("MISTRAL_API_KEY", ""),
) as mistral:

    res = mistral.beta.connectors.delete(connector_id="5c3269fe-6a18-4216-b1fb-b093005874cd")

    # Handle response
    print(res)


```

<ExpandablePropertyDescription slot="description">

Custom superset of RFC 8414 OAuth 2.0 Authorization Server Metadata.

Stored at connector creation time (provided for HTTP connectors, discovered via .well-known for MCP).

</ExpandablePropertyDescription>

<ExpandablePropertyDescription slot="description">

Custom superset of RFC 8414 OAuth 2.0 Authorization Server Metadata.

Stored at connector creation time (provided for HTTP connectors, discovered via .well-known for MCP).
Mirrors the shape of .well-known/oauth-authorization-server responses.

</ExpandablePropertyDescription>

#### ExtendedOAuthServerMetadata \{#operation-connector_update_v1_request_updatehttpconnectorrequest_auth_methods_authenticationmethodcreateorupdaterequest_oauth2_server_metadata_extendedoauthservermetadata\}

</ExpandableBreakoutTitle>

<ExpandableBreakoutDescription slot="description">

Custom superset of RFC 8414 OAuth 2.0 Authorization Server Metadata.

Stored at connector creation time (provided for HTTP connectors, discovered via .well-known for MCP).
Mirrors the shape of .well-known/oauth-authorization-server responses.

</ExpandableBreakoutDescription>

<ExpandablePropertyDescription slot="description">

HTTP status codes and reason phrases

Status codes from the following RFCs are all observed:

    * RFC 7231: Hypertext Transfer Protocol (HTTP/1.1), obsoletes 2616
    * RFC 6585: Additional HTTP Status Codes
    * RFC 3229: Delta encoding in HTTP
    * RFC 4918: HTTP Extensions for WebDAV, obsoletes 2518
    * RFC 5842: Binding Extensions to WebDAV
    * RFC 7238: Permanent Redirect
    * RFC 2295: Transparent Content Negotiation in HTTP
    * RFC 2774: An HTTP Extension Framework
    * RFC 7725: An HTTP Status Code to Report Legal Obstacles
    * RFC 7540: Hypertext Transfer Protocol Version 2 (HTTP/2)
    * RFC 2324: Hyper Text Coffee Pot Control Protocol (HTCPCP/1.0)
    * RFC 8297: An HTTP Status Code for Indicating Hints
    * RFC 8470: Using Early Data in HTTP

</ExpandablePropertyDescription>

<ExpandablePropertyDescription slot="description">

HTTP status codes and reason phrases

Status codes from the following RFCs are all observed:

    * RFC 7231: Hypertext Transfer Protocol (HTTP/1.1), obsoletes 2616
    * RFC 6585: Additional HTTP Status Codes
    * RFC 3229: Delta encoding in HTTP
    * RFC 4918: HTTP Extensions for WebDAV, obsoletes 2518
    * RFC 5842: Binding Extensions to WebDAV
    * RFC 7238: Permanent Redirect
    * RFC 2295: Transparent Content Negotiation in HTTP
    * RFC 2774: An HTTP Extension Framework
    * RFC 7725: An HTTP Status Code to Report Legal Obstacles
    * RFC 7540: Hypertext Transfer Protocol Version 2 (HTTP/2)
    * RFC 2324: Hyper Text Coffee Pot Control Protocol (HTCPCP/1.0)
    * RFC 8297: An HTTP Status Code for Indicating Hints
    * RFC 8470: Using Early Data in HTTP

</ExpandablePropertyDescription>
